SELECT cp.id AS project_id, cp.serial_number, cp.short_name, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, DATEDIFF(cp.end_date, cp.start_date) AS duration, t1.list_total_quantity, t2.scheduling_quantity, t1.list_total_weight, CASE WHEN t2.scheduling_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN t1.list_total_quantity - t2.scheduling_quantity > 0 THEN 2 WHEN t1.list_total_quantity - t2.scheduling_quantity = 0 THEN 4 END AS scheduling_status FROM contract_project cp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(quantity) AS list_total_quantity, SUM(total_net_weight) AS list_total_weight FROM tech_artifact WHERE bool_delete_enum = FALSE GROUP BY project_id ) t1 ON t1.project_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(quantity) AS scheduling_quantity FROM tech_artifact_ext WHERE bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND bool_beforehand_scheduling = TRUE GROUP BY project_id ) t2 ON t2.project_id = cp.id WHERE cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND YEAR(cp.create_time) = #{year}
AND t2.scheduling_quantity IS NULL
AND t1.list_total_quantity - t2.scheduling_quantity > 0
AND t1.list_total_quantity - t2.scheduling_quantity = 0
AND (cp.serial_number LIKE #{projectNoOrNameLike} OR cp.short_name LIKE #{projectNoOrNameLike} )

SELECT tae.production_way, tae.workshop_id, IF(tae.workshop_id IS NULL, '外协', mbw.name) AS workshop_name, SUM(tae.quantity) AS scheduling_quantity,
ROUND(ROUND(SUM(ls.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000, 2) / #{listTotalWeight}, 4) AS ratio,
ROUND(SUM(tae.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000, 2) AS scheduling_weight FROM tech_artifact_ext tae LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = tae.artifact_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbw.id = tae.workshop_id WHERE tae.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND tae.bool_beforehand_scheduling = TRUE
AND ls.project_id = #{projectId}
GROUP BY tae.production_way, tae.workshop_id
